newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Stet calls board meeting Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stet calls board meeting Jan 30.

text.p: Italian telecommunication holding Stet will hold a board meeting on January 30 to open the way for its planned merger with telephone operator Telecom Italia, a Stet source said.
Telecom Italia is expected to hold a board meeting on the same day.
The Stet source said the evaluators for the deal were expected to be announced at the board meetings.
The government is expected to release a statement later on Friday on the planned merger after a day of meeting with Stet executives and government ministers.
